MRX portable: FFmpeg source and provenance
===========================================

The portable build bundles one static LGPL FFmpeg binary as tools\ffmpeg.exe.
This note records where that binary comes from and which source matches it.
It deliberately does not claim that the sources of the external libraries
linked into the BtbN build are included, or that the binary can be rebuilt
byte for byte. All values are pinned in scripts\deps.json and verified by
scripts\fetch-deps.mjs before every build.

Bundled binary
--------------

  ffmpeg version: n9.0.2-17-g2a571b6068-20260930
  compiler (from -version): gcc 16.2.0 (crosstool-NG 1.29.0.7_b1a94f6)
  variant: win64, static, LGPL (BtbN "LGPL, static" build of the 9.0 branch)
  ffmpeg.exe SHA-256: 0e482b853f2fd4821055d20cdce510f0eea6027037c04b994f454a2136e8868e
  The exact configure line is written to LICENSES\FFmpeg-BUILD.txt by the
  build (ffmpeg -buildconf).

FFmpeg source
-------------

  upstream mirror: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg
  commit: 2a571b606854520cf89804d8030c8b328e621689
  commit page: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/2a571b606854520cf89804d8030c8b328e621689
  lineage (GitHub compare): 17 commits after tag n9.0.2 on branch release/9.0
  archive URL: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/archive/2a571b606854520cf89804d8030c8b328e621689.tar.gz
  archive SHA-256: f02fc0809a13f37e3d4e1f74254d07e035a5ef01a6d91e727b915b1764d97540
  shipped as: LICENSES\FFmpeg-SOURCE-ARCHIVE.tar.gz
  The archive contains FFmpeg's COPYING.GPLv2, COPYING.GPLv3,
  COPYING.LGPLv2.1 and COPYING.LGPLv3 files.

BtbN build
----------

  release: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/tag/autobuild-2026-09-30-13-08
  release title: Auto-Build 2026-09-30 13:08, published 2026-09-30T13:09:24Z
  artifact: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/autobuild-2026-09-30-13-08/ffmpeg-n9.0.2-17-g2a571b6068-win64-lgpl-9.0.zip
  artifact SHA-256: 6b264b9e6019103f601d98c292bd332fd87acf1c5e941ddff4fb71760fe63432
    (matches the release's checksums.sha256)
  checksums.sha256 SHA-256: e45436a222ab0de3b436940f4dbc5bd6df4d5929d19ed6122ce9c6ae57dd1fe6
    shipped as: LICENSES\FFmpeg-BtbN-CHECKSUMS.sha256
  recipe repository: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds
  recipe commit (the release tag's target): 6c9aec5fc9a72ec3abedd1fa84db141fa18cf52b
  recipe archive: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/archive/6c9aec5fc9a72ec3abedd1fa84db141fa18cf52b.tar.gz
  recipe archive SHA-256: 81da4f7c878dc0f60e6b8d0049a112e32178e20f025d468fe4e99e77b2dfe0ec
    shipped as: LICENSES\FFmpeg-BtbN-BUILD-SOURCE.tar.gz

Availability
------------

BtbN keeps daily auto-builds for about two weeks. The builds of the last day
of each month have stayed published for well over a year so far, which is
why a month-end build is pinned here; this is observed behaviour, not a
promise from BtbN. If the artifact URL disappears, place the zip with the
SHA-256 above at .cache\ffmpeg-n9.0.2-17-g2a571b6068-win64-lgpl-9.0.zip and
fetch-deps.mjs uses it without downloading. Switching to another build means
updating scripts\deps.json and this file together.
